# systray — GoGPU Ecosystem

> Pure Go system tray library for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Zero CGO.
> v0.2.0: multi-tray support, dynamic menu updates (SetLabel/SetChecked/SetDisabled/SetIcon).

## Docs

- [API Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/systray)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gogpu/systray/blob/main/AGENTS.md): AI agent instructions
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/gogpu/systray/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history
